entries.title: Paint identity and launch
entries.content: Windows 11 Paint is an MSIX WinUI 3 app. Use AUMID Microsoft.Paint_8wekyb3d8bbwe!App. The installed package observed on this host is 11.2605.81.0.

entries.title: Canvas is self-drawn
entries.content: The canvas has no actionable child-control tree. Resolve the canvas bounds through UIA, then use L4 pointer input and L5 visual verification.

entries.title: Canvas coordinate model
entries.content: Convert canvas coordinates through canvas bounds, zoom ratio, and scroll offsets. Never hard-code absolute screen coordinates or reuse a pre-zoom point.

entries.title: Implicit tool, brush, color, and layer state
entries.content: Tool, brush style, foreground color, and selected layer are implicit state. Tool and brush are separate ribbon groups and must be selected with group-local paths before drawing.

entries.title: Undo and pixel snapshot
entries.content: Paint declares Ctrl+Z at L0. Canvas writes also require an exported PNG or pixel snapshot at L1 because Ctrl+Z depth and conflict state cannot be trusted alone.
